For a model built over a strict subset of `n.snapshots`, `solve_model` calls `_call_extra_functionality(extra_functionality, n.snapshots)`, passing the full network index. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that index unchanged, so the callback receives more snapshots than the model was built over.
